cases.prompt: I own this PDF and asked for a metadata-only cleanup. The cleaned copy is now structurally invalid. Preserve the evidence, determine what sanitation actually happened, then find why the service corrupted the file.
cases.primary_decision: Establish the authorized sanitation result and artifact evidence before causal service debugging.
cases.anti_route: Do not keep applying broader cleanup options or treat the corruption as proof that the metadata target was removed.

cases.prompt: The refactor scope and approval are already settled. Apply the approved slices, but use explicit completion gates so every invariant and final count is proven before you report success.
cases.primary_decision: The refactor specialist owns what may change; unlazy overlays the accepted execution with measurable completion gates.
cases.anti_route: Do not let completion pressure expand the approved refactor or bypass its behavior-parity constraints.
